product_one_liner.value: Vim connects healthcare providers, payers, EHRs, and developers through a workflow platform that delivers data, tools, and AI applications at the point of care.
product_one_liner.notes: https://getvim.com/ describes the audiences served and the delivery of data, tools, actions, and AI-driven applications within point-of-care workflows.

pricing_page.notes: https://getvim.com/vim-canvas-pricing is a public page describing Vim Canvas packages and pricing options.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: https://getvim.com/case-studies/humana describes Humana's use of Vim for data exchange and capture. https://getvim.com/case-studies/mycare-medical states that MyCare Medical deployed Vim's point-of-care platform. | named_customers.0: Humana's case study describes using Vim to digitize data exchange and capture, establishing a customer deployment rather than an investor relationship. | named_customers.1: MyCare Medical's case study explicitly states that it deployed Vim's point-of-care platform.

employee_band.notes: https://getvim.com/press-kit reports 132 employees, which falls within the requested 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: https://getvim.com/press-kit explicitly lists New York, NY and Tel Aviv as headquarters; both are preserved rather than selecting one. | hq_country: https://getvim.com/press-kit lists headquarters in New York, NY and Tel Aviv, corresponding to the United States and Israel. Both headquarters are retained.

founded_year.notes: https://getvim.com/about-us explicitly dates Vim's founding to 2015.

eng_blog.notes: https://medium.com/getvim is an engineering-branded publication, but only one qualifying technical implementation post was verified: https://medium.com/getvim/using-node-js-to-write-safer-bash-scripts-ad6a523a5324. The other located post, https://medium.com/getvim/put-the-hack-back-in-hackathon-1a67f935c845, focuses on organizing a security hackathon rather than explaining product implementation. Thus the two-post threshold was not established. Confidence is low because the publication and category indexes did not expose a complete readable archive.

public_docs.notes: https://docs.getvim.com/ publicly links platform documentation, how-to guides, JavaScript SDK documentation, and API documentation. https://docs.getvim.com/change-log additionally exposes versioned developer release documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vim/jobs/7820586 is a live AI Ops Engineer posting, verified on November 10, 2026. The title explicitly qualifies under the requested AI-role criteria.

model_provider.notes: Unknown. https://getvim.com/documents/vim-applications-description/ refers to Vim Scribe's underlying AI-model technology without naming its provider. Product documentation, security/trust pages, relevant blog posts, and https://getvim.com/privacy-policy were reviewed without finding a named underlying product model or provider. No public subprocessor list was located. An internal Claude requirement and a third-party scribe integration were not treated as disclosures of Vim's underlying model.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://www.getvim.ai/trust-center explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II auditing and HIPAA compliance. HITRUST is omitted because it is outside the five requested frameworks. | compliance_certs.0: The trust center explicitly states that Vim is SOC 2 Type II audited. | compliance_certs.1: The trust center explicitly states that Vim is HIPAA-compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: https://getvim.com/about-us identifies the 2021 financing as Series C, consistent with the company funding record. | funding_date: https://getvim.com/news-and-events/vim-closes-investments dates the financing announcement to May 5, 2021, matching the funding record's 2021-05-05 date. The answer is normalized to YYYY-MM. A conflicting July 2021 entry in another funding profile leaves uncertainty. | funding_amount_usd: https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-israeli-digital-health-co-vim-raises-60-1001370051 reports a completed $60 million financing round, consistent with the funding record for getvim.com. This is preferred over the conflicting $24.7 million July 2021 entry at https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/166321-18; that discrepancy prevents high confidence.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest supported funding round dates to 2021, corroborated by https://getvim.com/news-and-events/vim-closes-investments and the funding history. Even the conflicting July 2021 funding-profile date is well outside the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vim/jobs/7722125 explicitly states that Vim is hiring two to three Enterprise Account Executives. The posting was verified on November 10, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest release on https://docs.getvim.com/change-log is March 10, 2026, and the dated integrated AI-scribe launch at https://getvim.com/news-and-events/vim-and-heidi-health-partner-to-accelerate-innovation-at-the-point-of-care is October 16, 2025. The readable 2026 archive at https://www.getvim.ai/media contains entries only through March 2026. These precede the six-month window; no qualifying in-window launch was found. Undated product messaging limits confidence.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. https://getvim.com/about-us lists the leadership roster without appointment dates. Reviewed profiles did not establish a qualifying change. https://linkedin.com/in/timothypbarry contains an unlabeled September 2026 date, which was insufficient to establish an executive departure. Neither a qualifying change nor a reliable negative could be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vim/jobs/7938820 explicitly assigns ownership of HubSpot and names integrations across Clay, HeyReach, and Meta Ads, establishing visible use of these CRM, sales, and marketing systems. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Revenue Operations Manager posting explicitly assigns end-to-end ownership of HubSpot. | crm_stack_signal.1: The Revenue Operations Manager posting explicitly names Clay in the operational integration stack. | crm_stack_signal.2: The Revenue Operations Manager posting explicitly names HeyReach in the operational integration stack. | crm_stack_signal.3: The Revenue Operations Manager posting explicitly names Meta Ads in the operational integration stack.
